summary_en: Interim and final dividend for FY3/27 increased by 3 yen each to 25 yen/share. Annual dividend raised from 44 yen to 50 yen/share. Increase reflects upgrade to cumulative Q2 and full-year consolidated earnings forecast.
title_en: Notice of Revision to FY3/27 Interim and Final Dividend Forecasts (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: On 5 August 2026, Press Kogyo's board approved increases to its FY3/27 (year ending 31 March 2027) interim and final dividend forecasts. The interim dividend was raised by 3 yen to 25 yen/share, and the final dividend was also raised by 3 yen to 25 yen/share, bringing total annual dividend from the previously announced 44 yen to 50 yen/share. The revision was driven by upward revisions to the company's cumulative Q2 and full-year consolidated earnings forecasts, details of which were disclosed separately on the same date. Prior year (FY3/26) paid 16 yen interim and 21 yen final (37 yen total).
